verdict.rationale: Chroma ships an official MCP server that lets Claude interact with Chroma's search capabilities, and its docs provide an agent prompt for natural-language setup. This gives first-party natural-language operation, but only through an external AI client, and the documented scope centers on search and memory rather than full administration. Missing for 10: native natural-language command interface within the product, documented coverage of collection management and admin operations via natural language, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Chroma MCP server allows Claude to directly interact with Chroma’s search capabilities through this standardized protocol.
Give the following prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your favorite AI agent. It will quickly set you up with Chroma.
